[ S. darpa], arrogance, pride, conceit ; Ja II 432, 23´ (matto ca ditto cā ti surāmadena matto ~ena ditto); Mil 414, 13 (na tena māno karaṇīyo na ~o dassetabbo); Sv 180, 1 (mānaṃ vā ~aṃ vā akatvā); Sadd 406, 26 (gabba ~e: ~o ahaṃkāro); — °- va(t) , mfn. , proud ; Mhv 25:33 (gajuttamo … °-vā); — see also arātidappappamāthi(n) ( sv arāti ), vādidappāpahāri(n) ( sv vādi[n] ).

dappita.p: [Dappa+ita] (ti) Google Translate Compare with Dukkhita (D, D, 2, 4, 6, M, D, 2.75, 23, 4). ဒပ် +⁇ + တ. Compare with Sukhita (Than, Thi, 2.210). ဒ ပ + ယ +⁇ တ. Niti, Dha. 235] (1) (a) arrogant, (b) arrogant; Arrogant He does not bow down because of pride. He has a strong body. (2) He is clear and happy. He is (3) arrogant. Dappita Rupa - Look. See original

DOP: dappati pr. 3 sg. [ S. dṛpyati], is mad or foolish; is arrogant; is delighted ; Dhātum 672 (dapa hāse); Sadd 487, 11 (dapa hāse: ~ati); Sv-pṭ I 293, 29 (~anti muyhantī ti dattū); — pp datta , dattu, ditta, mfn. [ cf S. dṛpta; see L. Alsdorf, 1977, p. 35 ], mad; foolish; wild; arrogant ; Abh 721 (bālo ~u jaḷo mūḷho); 1075 (gabbite ditto); D III 24, 2 (jarasigālo ditto c’ eva balavā ca; Sv 827, 23 : ditto ti dappito thūlasarīro); M I 383, 22 (ummatto si tvaṃ gahapati ~o si tvaṃ gahapati; Ps III 94, 3 : kiṃ jaḷo si jāto ti attho); Th 198 (so ’haṃ ditto tadā santo; Th-a II 65, 31 : paridappito samāno); Ja II 432, 15* (yadā matto ca ditto ca pamādā kumbham abbhidā; 432, 23´ : dappena ditto); V 232, 21* (svāyaṃ ~o va nadati, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee ditto; 232, 24´ : dappito viya); VI 192, 11* (ko nu brāhmaṇavaṇṇena ~o parisam āgato, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ditto; 192, 13´ : ~o ti dandho lāḷako, Ce, Ee so; Be ditto ti gabbito bālo dandhañāṇo; Se ~o ti dappito duṭṭho lāmako andhabālako); Sv 166, 14 (dattūhi bāla-manussehi); — dattupaññatta, mfn. , declared by fools ; D I 55, 28 (dattupaññattaṃ yad idaṃ dānaṃ tesaṃ tucchaṃ musā vilāpo ye keci atthikavādaṃ vadanti; Sv 166, 14 : dattūhi bālamanussehi paññattaṃ; Sv-pṭ I 293, 29 : dappanti muyhantī ti dattū, mūḷhā puggalā) = M I 515, 15 ; Ja IV 339, 14* (dattupaññattaṃ ye ca vadanti dānaṃ; 339, 18´ foll. : ye ca dānaṃ bālakehi paññattan ti vadanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee lālakehi); —dittarūpa, mfn. , absolutely wild or arrogant ; Ja III 263, 5* (taṃ dittarūpaṃ … vivajjayāmi); V 17, 1* (yaṃ ve pītvā dittarūpo va poso akkosatī pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se duṭṭharūpo; 19, 10´ : dittarūpo ti dappitarūpo, Be so; Ee gabbitarūpo; Ce, Se duṭṭharūpo ti dappitarūpo); VI 114, 10* (tā dittarūpā pati vippahāya, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se dhuttarūpā; 114, 27´ : saṭharūpā dhuttajātikā hutvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se asādhurūpā duṭṭharūpā dhuttajātikā); — caus. pp dappita , mfn. [ S. darpita], made arrogant; haughty, proud ; Ja III 256, 24´ (ditto ~o gijjho va, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee gabbito); V 301, 8´ (upatthaddhā ti atitthaddhā ~ā); Ap 68, 25 (gajarājā va ~o) ≠ 324, 6 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se dammito); Sv 539, 16 (ekacco pana dussīlo pi ~o viya vicarati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se adussīlo viya carati) = Mp III 328, 12 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se daḷito) ≠ Ud-a 417, 21 ( Ee adussīlo appito viya; Ce adussīlo apicchako viya; Be, Se susīlo viya carati); — atidappita, mfn. , very proud; too arrogant ; Ps II 382, 14 .

dāpana.p: [Dā+ṇāpe+yu.(dāpaṇa-prā)] (na) CL=8 to let him offering. (A) to be given bride to someone, ask for giving bride (Vivāha-maṅgalā). (B) to be clear and pure, answering the problem. (C) to be given wages, asking to give wages. (D) to be given him for punishment of property (fine to give assets/property).
a: ပေး-လှူ-စေခြင်း၊(က)သတိုးသမီးကို ပေးစေခြင်း၊ သမီးတောင်းခြင်း(ဝိဝါဟ-မင်္ဂလာ)။(ခ)သုတ်သင်-စင်ကြယ်-စေခြင်း၊ အမေး=ပုစ္ဆာကို ဖြေဆိုစေခြင်း။(ဂ)လုပ်-လက်-ခ ပေးစေခြင်း၊ လုပ်-လက်-ခ တောင်းခြင်း။(ဃ)ဥစ္စာဒဏ်ကို ပေးစေခြင်း၊ ငွေဒဏ်တပ်ခြင်း။ ဓနဒဏ္ဍ-ကြည့်။
